# Block Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-blocks-reference.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Blocks are entries in a YAML frontmatter `blocks:` array. This reference is generated from the full field schemas and canonical `BLOCK_EXAMPLES`, in deliberate registry order. Regenerate with `npm run generate-references`, or `npm run generate-blocks-reference` for this file alone.

See [Layouts](layouts.md) for rendering architecture, column matching, and styling. All source paths below are repository-root-relative.

## Reading the schemas

Schema types retain authoring semantics: `markdown`, `image`, and `reference` store strings; `array<T>` is a list of T. Dotted paths describe nested objects, and `[]` describes each list item. A required child is required only when its optional parent object is supplied (or for each supplied list object). Required fields must be supplied even when a default is shown.

The **Default** column shows the value the build fills in when a block omits the field, after validation and before rendering, so templates and authors can rely on it. Defaults of nested fields apply within each supplied parent object. `Derived` defaults depend on another field, as the description explains; `None` means an omitted field stays absent. Descriptions and usage notes may describe contextual/template behavior beyond schema validation.

**CMS collection availability** describes the schema's editor allowlist, not a runtime restriction. Site CMS customization can hide collections or blocks. Contextual blocks may still need page data to render usefully. **CMS label** identifies editor-exposed fields; `Not exposed` fields can still be authored in YAML.

## Common fields

`type` is a required string selecting a registered block. The common wrapper fields below come from `CONTAINER_FIELDS`. `dark` selects a dark section palette; `compact` reduces section padding. They affect full-width section wrappers, not direct column rendering; transparent `snippet` blocks do not acquire their own wrapper.

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dark` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Dark |  |
| `compact` | `boolean` | optional | None | Compact |  |

## `section-header`

Standalone section header with rich text intro.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/section-header.js`

**Component:** `block_section_header`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/section-header.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_base.scss`

**HTML root:** `<div class="section-header prose">`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `intro` | `markdown` | **required** | None | Section Header Intro | Rich text content rendered as markdown. Use headings and body text together. |
| `align` | `string` | optional | `"center"` | Not exposed | Text alignment. \`"center"\` adds \`.text-center\`. |
| `class` | `string` | optional | None | Not exposed | Extra CSS classes. |

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: section-header
    intro: >-
      ## Section headers introduce a page section


      Use one wherever a group of blocks needs a heading and a sentence of
      context.
```

## `features`

Grid of feature cards with optional icons, names, and descriptions.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/features.js`

**Component:** `block_features`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/features.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_feature.scss`

**HTML root:** `<ul class="features" role="list"> containing <li><article class="feature"> items`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `array<object>` | **required** | None | Features | Feature objects. Each: \`{icon, icon\_label, name, description, style}\`. Icon can be an Iconify ID (\`"prefix:name"\`), image path (\`"/images/foo.svg"\`), or raw HTML/emoji. |
| `items[].icon` | `string` | optional | None | Icon (Iconify ID or HTML entity) |  |
| `items[].icon_label` | `string` | optional | None | Icon Accessible Label |  |
| `items[].name` | `string` | **required** | None | Name |  |
| `items[].description` | `markdown` | optional | None | Description |  |
| `items[].style` | `string` | optional | None | Custom Style |  |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |
| `reveal` | `boolean` | optional | `true` | Not exposed | Adds \`data-reveal\` to each feature. |
| `center` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Centered | If true, centers feature text. |

**Usage notes:** On a full-width page the cards sit three to a row, so give the block a multiple of three items - three, six, nine - or the last row is left part-empty.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: features
    intro_content: "## A grid of features"
    items:
      - icon: hugeicons:cube
        name: Composable
        description: Pages are YAML lists of typed blocks.
      - icon: hugeicons:shield-01
        name: Validated
        description: Unknown types or keys fail the build loudly.
      - icon: hugeicons:rocket
        name: Static
        description: Everything renders to plain HTML at build time.
```

## `hero`

Full-width hero banner with optional badge, markdown content, and action buttons.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/hero.js`

**Component:** `block_hero`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/hero.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_hero.scss`

**HTML root:** `<header class="hero">`

**Container width:** `full`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `badge` | `string` | optional | None | Badge Text | Small pill label above the content. Renders as \`\<span class="badge">\`. |
| `content` | `markdown` | **required** | None | Content | Markdown content rendered in \`.prose\`. Start with a \`# Heading\`; paragraphs get \`body-lg\` size and muted color in a centered, guttered measure. |
| `buttons` | `array<object>` | optional | None | Buttons | Action buttons below the content. Each: \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Variants: \`"primary"\` (filled), \`"secondary"\` (outlined), \`"ghost"\` (transparent). Sizes: \`"sm"\`, \`"lg"\`, or omit for default. |
| `buttons[].text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `buttons[].href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `buttons[].variant` | `string` | optional | `"primary"` | Variant |  |
| `buttons[].size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `reveal` | `string` | optional | None | Not exposed | \`data-reveal\` value. |
| `class` | `string` | optional | None | CSS Class | Extra CSS classes on the \`\<header>\`. Use \`"gradient"\` for gradient bg. |

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: hero
    badge: Hero block
    content: >-
      # A full-width opening banner


      Start most pages with one of these: a heading, a sentence of context, and
      the actions that matter.
    buttons:
      - text: Primary action
        href: /how-it-works/
        variant: primary
        size: lg
      - text: Secondary
        href: /blocks/
        variant: secondary
        size: lg
```

## `split-image`

Two-column layout with text content and a responsive image.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/split-image.js`

**Component:** `block_split_image`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/split.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_split.scss`

**HTML root:** `<div class="split">`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subtitle` | `string` | optional | None | Subtitle | Subtitle with \`.text-muted\` styling. |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Main content with markdown headings (e.g. \`## Heading\`). Rendered through \`renderContent: "md"\` filter, wrapped in \`.prose\`. |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Reverse Layout | Reverses column order (content right, figure left) on desktop. |
| `reveal_content` | `string` | optional | Derived | Reveal Content Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the text side. Defaults to \`"left"\`, or \`"right"\` when \`reverse\` is true. |
| `reveal_figure` | `string` | optional | `"scale"` | Reveal Figure Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the figure side. |
| `button` | `object` | optional | None | Button | \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Rendered below content. |
| `button.text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `button.href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `button.variant` | `string` | optional | `"secondary"` | Variant |  |
| `button.size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `figure_src` | `image` | **required** | None | Figure Image | Image path. |
| `figure_alt` | `string` | optional | None | Figure Alt Text | Alt text for the image. |
| `figure_caption` | `string` | optional | None | Figure Caption | Visible caption below the image. |

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: split-image
    subtitle: Split layouts
    content: >-
      ## Text beside an image


      The figure sits on the right by default; set `reverse: true` to flip the
      columns.
    figure_src: fireworks.jpg
    figure_alt: Fireworks over a city at night
    figure_caption: Captions are optional.
```

Two-column layout with text content and an embedded video.

**Component:** `block_split_video`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/split.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_split.scss`

**HTML root:** `<div class="split">`

**Container width:** `wide`

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subtitle` | `string` | optional | None | Subtitle | Subtitle with \`.text-muted\` styling. |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Main content with markdown headings (e.g. \`## Heading\`). Rendered through \`renderContent: "md"\` filter, wrapped in \`.prose\`. |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Reverse Layout | Reverses column order (content right, figure left) on desktop. |
| `reveal_content` | `string` | optional | Derived | Reveal Content Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the text side. Defaults to \`"left"\`, or \`"right"\` when \`reverse\` is true. |
| `reveal_figure` | `string` | optional | `"scale"` | Reveal Figure Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the figure side. |
| `button` | `object` | optional | None | Button | \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Rendered below content. |
| `button.text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `button.href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `button.variant` | `string` | optional | `"secondary"` | Variant |  |
| `button.size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `figure_video_id` | `string` | **required** | None | Video ID or embed URL | Bare YouTube video ID (e.g. \`dQw4w9WgXcQ\`), or the full embed URL of another provider (Vimeo, Bunny Stream). Never an \`\<iframe>\` snippet. |
| `figure_thumbnail_url` | `string` | optional | None | Thumbnail | Image path or URL shown behind the play button. Defaults to the provider's own thumbnail for a YouTube ID or a Vimeo URL; other providers show a plain panel. |
| `figure_alt` | `string` | optional | `"Video"` | Video Name | Name of the video, used for the play button's label and the iframe's title. |
| `figure_caption` | `string` | optional | None | Video Caption | Visible caption below the video. |
| `figure_autoplay` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Autoplay | If true, skips the play button and starts the video muted, with its controls showing, when it scrolls into view. |

**Usage notes:** Without \`figure\_autoplay\` the video loads only when its play button is pressed.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: split-video
    subtitle: Split layouts
    content: |-
      ## Text beside a video

      The video loads when a visitor presses play.
    figure_video_id: dQw4w9WgXcQ
    figure_thumbnail_url: dinner.jpg
    figure_alt: A YouTube video
    figure_caption: Captions are optional.
```

| `reveal_content` | `string` | optional | Derived | Reveal Content Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the text side. Defaults to \`"left"\`, or \`"right"\` when \`reverse\` is true. |
| `reveal_figure` | `string` | optional | `"scale"` | Reveal Figure Animation | \`data-reveal\` for the figure side. |
| `button` | `object` | optional | None | Button | \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Rendered below content. |
| `button.text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `button.href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `button.variant` | `string` | optional | `"secondary"` | Variant |  |
| `button.size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `figure_html` | `markdown` | **required** | None | Figure HTML Content | Raw HTML content for the figure side. |

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: split-html
    subtitle: Split layouts
    content: |-
      ## Text beside custom HTML

      The figure column renders whatever HTML you give it.
    figure_html: <p style="font-size:3rem;text-align:center">&#127881;</p>
```

## `split-full`

Full-width two-panel layout with distinct background colors per side.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/split-full.js`

**Container width:** `full`

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `string` | optional | None | Variant | Color scheme: \`"dark-left"\`, \`"dark-right"\`, \`"primary-left"\`, \`"primary-right"\`. |
| `left_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Left Content | Left panel content with markdown headings (e.g. \`## Heading\`). Rendered as markdown via \`.prose\`. |
| `left_button` | `object` | optional | None | Left Button | \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. |
| `left_button.text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `left_button.href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `left_button.variant` | `string` | optional | `"secondary"` | Variant |  |
| `left_button.size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `right_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Right Content | Right panel content with markdown headings (e.g. \`## Heading\`). Rendered as markdown via \`.prose\`. |
| `right_button` | `object` | optional | None | Right Button | \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. |
| `right_button.text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `right_button.href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |

| `reveal_right` | `string` | optional | None | Reveal Right Animation | \`data-reveal\` for right panel. |

**Usage notes:** Variants: \`"dark-left"\` / \`"dark-right"\` (dark bg + light text), \`"primary-left"\` / \`"primary-right"\` (\`--color-link\` bg + contrast text). Button colors automatically invert in dark/primary panels. The parent \`\<section>\` has zero padding — panels handle their own padding.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: split-full
    variant: dark-left
    left_content: |-
      ## Two panels

      Each side takes its own content and button.
    left_button:
      text: Left action
      href: /how-it-works/
      variant: secondary
    right_content: |-
      ## Side by side

      Variants control which side is dark.
    right_button:
      text: Right action
      href: /blocks/
```

Full-width image background with hero-style overlay content (badge, markdown content, buttons) and optional parallax.

**Component:** `block_image_background`

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `image_alt` | `string` | optional | `"Background image"` | Image Alt Text | Alt text. |
| `class` | `string` | optional | None | CSS Class | Extra CSS classes. |
| `badge` | `string` | optional | None | Badge Text | Small pill label above the content. Renders as \`\<span class="badge">\`. |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Markdown overlay content rendered in \`.prose\` inside the \`\<figcaption>\`. |
| `buttons` | `array<object>` | optional | None | Buttons | Action buttons below the content. Each: \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Variants: \`"primary"\` (filled), \`"secondary"\` (outlined), \`"ghost"\` (transparent). Sizes: \`"sm"\`, \`"lg"\`, or omit for default. |

| `buttons[].href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `buttons[].variant` | `string` | optional | `"primary"` | Variant |  |

**Usage notes:** Image processed via \`{% image %}\` at widths 2560/1920/1280/960/640, cropped to 16/9. Parallax uses \`animation-timeline: scroll()\` for native CSS scroll-driven translation.

```yaml
blocks:
```

## `video-background`

Full-width video playing silently behind hero-style overlay content (badge, markdown content, buttons).

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/video-background.js`

**Component:** `block_video_background`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/video-background.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_video-background.scss`

**Container width:** `full`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `video_id` | `string` | **required** | None | Video ID or embed URL | Bare YouTube video ID (e.g. \`dQw4w9WgXcQ\`); the block builds the embed itself. For other providers (Vimeo, Bunny Stream), the full embed URL. Never an \`\<iframe>\` snippet. |
| `video_title` | `string` | optional | `"Background video"` | Video Title | Accessible \`title\` on the iframe. |
| `thumbnail_url` | `string` | optional | None | Thumbnail | Image path or URL shown over the iframe while the video loads. Defaults to the provider's own thumbnail for a YouTube ID or a Vimeo URL; other providers show nothing until the video plays. |
| `class` | `string` | optional | None | CSS Class | Extra CSS classes. |
| `badge` | `string` | optional | None | Badge Text | Small pill label above the content. Renders as \`\<span class="badge">\`. |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Markdown overlay content rendered in \`.prose\` inside the \`\<figcaption>\`. |
| `buttons` | `array<object>` | optional | None | Buttons | Action buttons below the content. Each: \`{text, href, variant, size}\`. Variants: \`"primary"\` (filled), \`"secondary"\` (outlined), \`"ghost"\` (transparent). Sizes: \`"sm"\`, \`"lg"\`, or omit for default. |
| `buttons[].text` | `string` | **required** | None | Button Text |  |
| `buttons[].href` | `string` | **required** | None | URL |  |
| `buttons[].variant` | `string` | optional | `"primary"` | Variant |  |
| `buttons[].size` | `string` | optional | None | Size |  |
| `reveal` | `string` | optional | None | Not exposed | \`data-reveal\` value. |

**Usage notes:** YouTube IDs become \`youtube-nocookie.com\` embeds that autoplay muted, loop, and hide their controls; the thumbnail fades out once the player reports it is playing. Vimeo URLs gain autoplay, loop, and mute. A Bunny Stream embed URL is used as written, so set its \`autoplay\`, \`loop\`, and \`muted\` parameters yourself; its thumbnail fades out when the player starts, through a small script loaded only on pages with a Bunny background. The video is decorative: put anything a visitor must know in the overlay content.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: video-background
    video_id: dQw4w9WgXcQ
    thumbnail_url: city-traffic-night.jpg
    badge: Video background
    content: |-
      # Content over a full-width video

      The thumbnail shows until the video is playing.
```

## `items`

Displays an Eleventy collection as a card grid or horizontal slider.

```yaml
  - type: items
    collection: news
    intro_content: |-
      ## A collection as cards

      This example renders the `news` collection.
```

When the resolved value is an array, the operator runs against each element (per-element exact match for \`equals\`, per-element substring for \`includes\`). \`includes\` matches substring; \`equals\` matches exact value. |
| `filter.property` | `string` | optional | None | Property (e.g. url, data.name) |  |
| `filter.includes` | `string` | optional | None | Contains |  |

## `table-of-contents`

In-page contents built from the headings the page actually renders.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/table-of-contents.js`

**Component:** `block_table_of_contents`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/table-of-contents.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_table-of-contents.scss`

**HTML root:** `<nav class="table-of-contents">`

**Container width:** `narrow`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | optional | `"On this page"` | Title | Heading above the list, and the accessible name of the navigation landmark. |
| `levels` | `string` | optional | `"2,3"` | Heading Levels | Comma-separated heading levels to list, from \`2\` to \`6\`. Every other level is left out of the list, so \`"2"\` gives a top-level-only contents. An unlistable level fails the build. |

**Usage notes:** The list is filled in after the page renders, from the headings in the page's main content at the levels this block names — no matter which blocks wrote them. Each listed heading gets an \`id\` (its own, when it already has one) so the links are stable, and the entries nest the way the headings do. A page whose headings none of the named levels match fails the build rather than publishing an empty contents.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: table-of-contents
    title: On this page
    levels: 2,3
```

**Component:** `block_iframe_embed`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/iframe-embed.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_iframe-embed.scss`

**HTML root:** `<div class="iframe-embed">`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | **required** | None | Iframe URL | Full URL of the iframe to embed. |
| `name` | `string` | **required** | None | Accessible Name | Accessible name (rendered as the iframe's \`title\` attribute). |
| `width` | `number` | optional | None | Width (px) | Fixed pixel width. Omit to fill the container. |
| `height` | `number` | optional | None | Height (px) | Fixed pixel height. Required for non-responsive embeds unless \`aspect\_ratio\` is set. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `string` | optional | None | Aspect Ratio (e.g. 16/9) | CSS \`aspect-ratio\` for responsive height, e.g. \`"16/9"\`. Alternative to \`height\`. |
| `max_width` | `string` | optional | None | Max Width (CSS, e.g. 560px) | CSS max-width on the wrapper, e.g. \`"560px"\`. |
| `sandbox` | `string` | optional | None | Sandbox | Space-separated sandbox tokens, e.g. \`"allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms"\`. |
| `allow` | `string` | optional | None | Allow (permissions policy) | \`allow\` attribute for iframe permissions policy. |
| `scrolling` | `string` | optional | None | Scrolling | Legacy \`scrolling\` attribute, e.g. \`"no"\`. |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** Provide either \`height\` for a fixed-height embed or \`aspect\_ratio\` (e.g. \`16/9\`) for a responsive one. Use \`max\_width\` to cap the embed width within the container.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: iframe-embed
    src: /search/
    name: The search page, embedded
    aspect_ratio: 16/9
    max_width: 560px
```

## `faqs`

Renders question/answer pairs as a definition list, or as collapsed accordions with \`collapsible: true\`. Available on all page types.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/faqs.js`

**Component:** `block_faqs`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/faqs.html`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `array<object>` | optional | None | FAQs | FAQ question/answer pairs. Answers support markdown formatting. Falls back to page-level \`faqs\` array if omitted. |
| `items[].question` | `string` | **required** | None | Question |  |
| `items[].answer` | `markdown` | optional | None | Answer (Markdown) |  |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Collapsible | Collapse each answer under its question, opened by selecting the question (native details/summary, no JavaScript). |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** Define FAQs inline via \`items\`, or omit to fall back to the page-level \`faqs\` array (useful for pages and guide pages that declare FAQs in frontmatter). Answers are rendered as markdown.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: faqs
    intro_content: "## Frequently asked questions"
    items:
      - question: How are FAQ answers formatted?
        answer: Answers support **markdown**, including links and lists.
      - question: Where else can FAQs come from?
        answer: Omit `items` and the block falls back to the page-level `faqs` array.
```

Each: \`{image, alt, link\_url}\`. \`image\` is a path; \`alt\` is optional alt text; \`link\_url\` is an optional URL to wrap the image in a link. Images are processed via the \`{% image %}\` shortcode for responsive formats and proper URL normalization. |
| `items[].image` | `string` | **required** | None | Image Path |  |
| `items[].alt` | `string` | optional | None | Alt Text |  |
| `items[].link_url` | `string` | optional | None | Link URL |  |

## `video-cards`

Grid of click-to-play video thumbnails. Takes YouTube IDs and the embed URLs of other providers (Vimeo, Bunny Stream).

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/video-cards.js`

**Component:** `block_video_cards`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/video-cards.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_items.scss`

**HTML root:** `<ul class="items" role="list">`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `videos` | `array<object>` | **required** | None | Videos | Video objects. Each: \`{id, name, thumbnail\_url}\`. \`id\` is a bare YouTube video ID (e.g. \`dQw4w9WgXcQ\`) or the full embed URL of another provider (Vimeo, Bunny Stream); never an \`\<iframe>\` snippet. \`thumbnail\_url\` is an image path or URL, and defaults to the provider's own thumbnail for a YouTube ID or a Vimeo URL. |
| `videos[].id` | `string` | **required** | None | Video ID or embed URL |  |
| `videos[].name` | `string` | **required** | None | Name |  |
| `videos[].thumbnail_url` | `string` | optional | None | Thumbnail |  |
| `reveal` | `boolean` | optional | `true` | Not exposed | Adds \`data-reveal\` to each video. |
| `expand` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Expand to Full Width | If true, videos fill the available width (1 = 100%, 2 = 50%, 3+ = 33.3%) instead of the standard card grid. |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** A video loads only when its thumbnail is pressed, so the grid costs nothing until a visitor plays one. A YouTube or Vimeo thumbnail with no \`thumbnail\_url\` is downloaded at build time, so a build with one needs the network; a video from another provider with no \`thumbnail\_url\` shows a plain panel behind the play button.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: video-cards
    videos:
      - id: dQw4w9WgXcQ
        name: A YouTube video
        thumbnail_url: breakfast.jpg
      - id: https://player.vimeo.com/video/76979871
        name: A Vimeo video
        thumbnail_url: lunch.jpg
      - id: https://iframe.mediadelivery.net/embed/1/example
        name: A video with no thumbnail
```

## `reviews`

Customer reviews as cards, newest first: rating, date, the reviewer's words, and a link to where they wrote it.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/reviews.js`

**Component:** `block_reviews`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/reviews.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_reviews.scss`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minimum_rating` | `number` | optional | `1` | Minimum Rating | Only reviews rated at least this are shown, from \`1\` (every review) to \`5\`. |
| `limit` | `number` | optional | None | Limit | Show at most this many reviews, newest first. |
| `horizontal` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Horizontal Slider | If true, renders as a horizontal slider instead of a wrapping grid. |
| `masonry` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Masonry Grid | If true, renders as a masonry grid using uWrap for zero-reflow height prediction. |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** Renders the \`reviews\` collection: one markdown file per review in \`src/reviews/\`, named \`YYYY-MM-DD-reviewer.md\`, with \`name\`, \`rating\`, and optional \`source\`, \`url\`, and \`avatar\` (the reviewer's photo; their initial shows without one) in the frontmatter and the review as the body. \`npm run fetch-reviews\` writes these files from Google, Facebook and Trustpilot. A review with \`hidden: true\` is left out. The block renders nothing when no review qualifies.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: reviews
    minimum_rating: 4
    limit: 6
    intro_content: "## What customers say"
```

## `contact-form`

A contact form, optionally beside text, that posts to a form service.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/contact-form.js`

**Component:** `block_contact_form`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/contact-form.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_contact-form.scss`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Text shown beside the form, rendered as markdown. Without it the form takes the full width. |
| `fields` | `array<object>` | optional | `[{"name":"name","label":"Name","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"email","label":"Email","type":"email","required":true},{"name":"phone","label":"Phone","type":"tel","required":false},{"name":"message","label":"Message","type":"textarea","required":true,"rows":6}]` | Form Fields | The form's fields, in order. Defaults to name, email, phone, and message. |
| `fields[].label` | `string` | **required** | None | Label |  |
| `fields[].name` | `string` | optional | Derived | Name | Name the answer is submitted under. Defaults to the label. |
| `fields[].type` | `string` | optional | `"text"` | Type | \`textarea\`, \`select\`, \`radio\`, \`heading\` (a sub-heading between fields, with \`note\` as its text), or any HTML input type such as \`text\`, \`email\`, \`tel\`, \`date\`, or \`number\`. |
| `fields[].required` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Required |  |
| `fields[].placeholder` | `string` | optional | None | Placeholder |  |
| `fields[].note` | `string` | optional | None | Help Note |  |
| `fields[].options` | `array<string>` | optional | None | Options | Choices of a \`select\` or \`radio\` field. |
| `fields[].rows` | `number` | optional | `6` | Rows | Height of a \`textarea\`, in lines of text. |
| `submit_text` | `string` | optional | `"Send Enquiry"` | Submit Button Text |  |
| `redirect` | `string` | optional | `"/thank-you/"` | Redirect | Page a visitor lands on after sending the form. |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** A static site cannot receive a form, so the block posts to the URL in the \`contact\_form\_target\` setting, or to \[Formspark\](https://formspark.io/) when \`formspark\_id\` is set; with neither it shows a notice in place of the form. Setting \`botpoison\_public\_key\` adds a \[Botpoison\](https://botpoison.com/) spam challenge, which needs JavaScript. The submission emails are named after the site, and a field named \`email\` becomes their reply address on Formspark.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: contact-form
    content: |-
      ## Get in touch

      Tell us what you need and we will get back to you.
    fields:
      - label: Name
        name: name
        required: true
      - label: Email
        name: email
        type: email
        required: true
      - label: What do you need?
        name: service
        type: select
        options:
          - A new website
          - Help with an existing site
          - Something else
      - label: Message
        name: message
        type: textarea
        required: true
```

## `quote-form`

The visitor's quote: the products they added, an estimated price, and a form that sends the request to a form service.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/quote-form.js`

**Component:** `block_quote_form`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/quote-form.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_quote.scss`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** No

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Content | Text shown beside the form, rendered as markdown. Without it the form takes the full width. |
| `fields` | `array<object>` | optional | `[{"name":"name","label":"Name","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"email","label":"Email","type":"email","required":true},{"name":"phone","label":"Phone","type":"tel","required":false},{"name":"start_date","label":"Start date","type":"date","required":true},{"name":"end_date","label":"End date","type":"date","required":true},{"name":"message","label":"Anything else we should know?","type":"textarea","required":false,"rows":4}]` | Form Fields | The form's fields, in order. Defaults to name, email, phone, start and end dates, and a message. |
| `fields[].label` | `string` | **required** | None | Label |  |
| `fields[].name` | `string` | optional | Derived | Name | Name the answer is submitted under. Defaults to the label. |
| `fields[].type` | `string` | optional | `"text"` | Type | \`textarea\`, \`select\`, \`radio\`, \`heading\` (a sub-heading between fields, with \`note\` as its text), or any HTML input type such as \`text\`, \`email\`, \`tel\`, \`date\`, or \`number\`. |
| `fields[].required` | `boolean` | optional | `false` | Required |  |
| `fields[].placeholder` | `string` | optional | None | Placeholder |  |
| `fields[].note` | `string` | optional | None | Help Note |  |
| `fields[].options` | `array<string>` | optional | None | Options | Choices of a \`select\` or \`radio\` field. |
| `fields[].rows` | `number` | optional | `6` | Rows | Height of a \`textarea\`, in lines of text. |
| `submit_text` | `string` | optional | `"Request a Quote"` | Submit Button Text |  |
| `redirect` | `string` | optional | `"/quote-sent/"` | Redirect | Page a visitor lands on after sending the form. |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |

**Usage notes:** Products carry an add-to-quote button; this block lists what was added, kept in the visitor's browser, with a quantity for each and an estimated total. It posts like the \`contact-form\` block, to \`contact\_form\_target\` or Formspark, adding the items as \`cart\_items\`, the total as \`estimated\_total\`, and the number of hire days as \`hire\_days\`. Hire products are priced by the days between the \`start\_date\` and \`end\_date\` fields, counting both ends; a stay with no matching option is priced TBC. The quote is cleared once it is sent. Prices are shown in the \`currency\` setting.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: quote-form
    content: |-
      ## Your quote

      Add products to see them here.
```

## `downloads`

List of downloadable files. Each item auto-detects its icon from the file extension and its size from the filesystem at build time.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/downloads.js`

**Component:** `block_downloads`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/downloads.html`

**SCSS:** `src/css/design-system/_downloads.scss`

**HTML root:** `<ul class="downloads" role="list">`

**Container width:** `narrow`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `intro_content` | `markdown` | optional | None | Intro Content (Markdown) | Markdown content rendered above the block in \`.prose\`. |
| `items` | `array<object>` | **required** | None | Downloads | Download objects. Each: \`{file, label}\`. \`file\` is a site-relative URL path; \`label\` is the visible text. |
| `items[].file` | `string` | **required** | None | File Path (e.g. /files/guide.pdf) |  |
| `items[].label` | `string` | **required** | None | Label |  |
| `reveal` | `boolean` | optional | `true` | Not exposed | Adds \`data-reveal\` to each download item. |

**Usage notes:** The \`file\` path is resolved against \`src/\` (e.g. \`/files/guide.pdf\` reads from \`src/files/guide.pdf\`). Missing files cause a build error. Ensure the containing directory is configured as a passthrough-copy target so the file is also served to the browser.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: downloads
    intro_content: "## Files to download"
    items:
      - file: /files/template-overview.txt
        label: Template overview (TXT)
```

## `snippet`

Renders blocks from a named snippet file, enabling reusable block compositions.

**Schema:** `src/_lib/utils/block-schema/snippet.js`

**Component:** `block_snippet`

**Template:** `src/_includes/design-system/blocks/snippet.html`

**Container width:** `wide`

**CMS collection availability:** All collections with a block editor

**Columns:** Yes

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | `reference` | **required** | None | Snippet | Filename of the snippet (without \`.md\` extension) from \`src/snippets/\`. CMS options: {"collection":"snippets"} |

**Usage notes:** The referenced snippet must exist in \`src/snippets/\` and have a \`blocks\` frontmatter array. The snippet block is transparent — it renders no wrapping section element, so each inner block renders its own section directly.

### Canonical example

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: snippet
    reference: demo
```
